messages:
alyssa (partnerships): looping folks in — SI partner wants a bundled Datadog + OTLP integration for their customers. main asks: simple onboarding, pre-baked dashboard, clear sampling guidance, and privacy notes for model metadata.
devin (obs eng): ok. recommend default adaptive sampling at SDK level + a forcing rule for error spans. keeps costs down but preserves failure signals.
raj (sales-eng): their sales lead insisted on a single-pane summary for execs and a compact ops view for SREs. execs want cost and ROI; SREs want p95, error-rate, and service map.
devin (obs eng): service map needs consistent service naming. propose normalizer: `org_id`, `tenant_slug`, `service_short`. we'll add a post-processor step in the collector to rewrite `service.name`.
alyssa (partnerships): can we include a tiny sample collector config and a marketplace doc snippet saying "do not paste production API keys"? legal needs that language.
hua (legal): yes — include explicit warning and link to secure key storage guidance. we prefer wording: "Use a scoped ingest key with least privilege. Do not embed keys in public repos".
devin (obs eng): sample OTLP + processor for tag normalization (sanitized):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  attributes/sanitize:
    actions:
      - key: service.name
        action: update
        value: "${tenant_slug}-${service_short}"
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: https://trace.agent.datadoghq.com:443
    headers:
      DD-API-KEY: "<REDACTED>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes/sanitize]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
raj (sales-eng): nice. for the marketplace tile can we surface three selectable vars: `tenant`, `region`, `deployment`? Also a short blurb: "One-click Datadog dashboards + OTLP-ready collector configs."
alyssa (partnerships): yes. i'll draft the blurb. design asks for a small screenshot + a link to try the dashboard in staging.
devin (obs eng): dashboard recommendation: 4 widgets: 1) summary row with tokens_cost_estimate (derived), p95 latency, error rate; 2) timeseries p95 latency; 3) trace flamegraph/sample waterfall (Datadog trace view); 4) table of top models by requests. include template vars: `tenant` and `env`.
raj (sales-eng): include a short how-to: enable OTLP receiver, set `attributes.sanitize` rules, point to Datadog endpoint, then enable dashboard from marketplace tile. keeps onboarding to ~10 minutes.
hua (legal): also add privacy bullet: "Strip full prompts from traces/logs; only include model identifier and token counts."
alys sa (partnerships): small nit: spelling - my name is alyssa :)
alyssa (partnerships): oops sorry :) updated.
integrations-bot: ci: dashboard lint OK, collector snippets scanned for secrets — no secrets found. preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/integrations/dd-otel-tenant-preview (expires in 72h).
devin (obs eng): i'll commit the collector example to `integrations/collector-templates/dd-otel/` and add a README with sampling guidance and a quick troubleshooting FAQ.
raj (sales-eng): i'll prepare a one-slide exec summary (cost delta + benefits) for partner onboarding docs.
alyssa (partnerships): action list: me — marketplace blurb + screenshot; devin — push collector + README; raj — exec slide; hua — finalize legal copy. target: demo for partner next Wednesday. ping here if anything slips. :party-parrot:
